使用机器的 DATA 接口连接电脑，在 Chrome 或 Edge 中打开本页，: Connect the sampler’s DATA port to your computer. Open this page in Chrome or Edge, click “Connect SXC-1” and allow MIDI / SysEx access. Close the official app and any other program accessing SXC-1 while connected.
每页对应一个 Bank，连接时打开机器当前 Bank，网页翻页时机器同步切换。将: Each page represents one bank. Connecting opens the sampler’s current bank; navigating banks here also changes the sampler’s bank. Dragging a WAV onto an empty pad checks, converts and uploads it immediately. Occupied pads reject drops. Preview first reads the sample, then plays it on your computer. The top-right Loop button controls browser preview only and can be toggled during playback. WAV downloads retain the original files. A bank ZIP includes all files, pad settings and a checksum manifest. Empty pads do not create placeholder audio.
“批量上传采样”支持多选音频或拖入文件夹（包含子文件夹），按路径和文件名从指定: Batch import accepts multiple audio files or folders, including subfolders. Files fill consecutive pads from the selected bank and pad, sorted by path and filename. The entire range and every audio file are checked first. Occupied or out-of-range destinations prevent uploading; the queue remains available for retry. Closing the dialog retains the queue, but refreshing clears it. Batch import does not restore pad settings from backups; use copy/paste to preserve complete settings.
选择“打开备份文件夹”时，请选择包含 manifest.json 和 Bank0: When opening a backup folder, select the root containing manifest.json and folders such as Bank01, or the extracted bank ZIP folder. Selected files are read only within this page.
读取失败或取消后，重新连接设备即可继续。下载期间不要更改机器上的采样。网页单个文: After a read failure or cancellation, reconnect to continue. Do not change samples on the sampler during downloads. The browser limits individual downloads to 256 MB and bank downloads to 512 MB. Uploads accept mono/stereo WAV files up to 60 seconds (PCM 8/16/24/32-bit or Float 32-bit), converted locally to 48 kHz / 16-bit stereo. Only empty pads are accepted. Uploads use One Shot playback at 100% level and do not preserve source loop points. Do not operate the sampler or connect the official app during uploads.
有采样的 Pad 可点击“复制”，再到同一或其他 Bank 的空 Pad 点击“: Copy an occupied pad, then paste it into an empty pad in the same or another bank. Copying retains original WAV audio, waveforms, start/end points, pad settings and associated files with the same filename prefix, without re-encoding. Patterns are not included. Each copied file is limited to 64 MB. Edit supports Level, Pitch, Group, LED Color, Pan, One Shot, Loop and BPM. Saving verifies both live parameters and saved device files. Edit reports retain before/after settings.
在线版直接通过 HTTPS 地址使用；本地版可通过 localhost 服务或附: Use the hosted version over HTTPS or serve the local version from localhost. Browser preview plays the original WAV without simulating the sampler’s playback settings. Audio is processed locally and is not uploaded to a server. The browser retains the latest upload and edit reports locally. Leaving the page clears temporary audio and the pad clipboard; downloaded files remain on your computer.
非官方工具，与 CASIO 无隶属关系。已在 macOS / Chrome /: Unofficial tool, not affiliated with CASIO. The original author reports hardware validation on macOS / Chrome / firmware 1.4.1.

“备份全部 Bank”会检查全部 80 个 Bank，仅将含有音频数据的 Pad: Back up all banks checks all 80 banks and saves pads containing audio plus their associated files to a new subfolder on your computer. Empty banks, pads without audio and zero-byte files are skipped; silent recordings are preserved. Patterns and global settings are excluded. Cancellation or failure retains saved files, but the backup must be treated as incomplete.
